meanings.note: Запись идёт = it is recording. Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'пись'). Common feminine noun meaning 'recording; entry, appointment' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: A fact or a person. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to know'.

examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: A person's own room at work. From French 'cabinet' (private study or office).

examples.text: Николай Филиппович, я сейчас в кабинете у мэра.
examples.trans: Nikolai Filippovich, I'm in the mayor's office right now.

meanings.note: Device for recording video. Common feminine noun meaning 'camera, video camera' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Of course, everything is recorded on camera.

examples.text: Нужно ходить по городу с камерой!
examples.trans: You need to walk around town with a camera!

meanings.note: Declinable neuter noun meaning 'recording', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Я вам звоню, а вы не отвечаете!
examples.trans: I call you, and you don't answer!

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

examples.trans: Talk to Arakelyan. Get him to withdraw his statement.

meanings.note: Подожди! = wait!. Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to wait (a while)', paired with 'ждать'.

meanings.note: On foot. Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to go (set off)', paired with 'идти'.

examples.trans: Shall we show this to Anikeev?

meanings.note: Простите! = sorry! forgive me!. Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'стить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forgive; (imperative) excuse me', paired with 'прощать'.

Imperative: прости / простите. Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'стить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forgive; (imperative) excuse me', paired with 'прощать'.
